present.product.orb.text: This is The Orb. Interactive object. A 3D sphere for your own work, in twenty versions: glass, metal, porcelain, bloom, and glass with light, sparkle or beads inside. Try its versions, then add it to your cart, save it, or take it to Studio.

reply.missed.text: I didn’t catch that. Tap me and try again.

reply.help.text: I can take you anywhere here. Say Products, Templates, Studio, Sound or Membership, or name a piece, like the Slider or the Wave. You can also ask me where you are.

reply.thanks.text: With pleasure. I’m right here when you need me.

reply.who.text: I’m the Light Orb, the guide of this place. A little light made of glass. I show you around and I answer when you call.

reply.hello.text: Hello. It’s lovely to hear you. Where would you like to go? Products, Templates, Studio or Sound?

reply.unknown.text: I’m still learning words. Try Products, Templates, Studio, Sound, or ask me where you are.

reply.mic.text: Allow the microphone to talk with me.
